paragraphs: The plant watering reminder system based on the STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller and capacitive soil moisture sensor was successfully designed, implemented, and verified. The system demonstrates the integration of analog acquisition, multi-sample digital filtering, I2C graphical display rendering, and active-low GPIO actuation.

The capacitive measurement technique eliminates sensor probe degradation, while the ARM Cortex-M3 processor delivers rapid 72 MHz computation with minimal power consumption. The resulting unit provides a self-contained, dependable tool for soil hydration monitoring.
